'''Star Tours Flight 114''' was the designation of two Star Tours flights:

The first was a [[StarSpeeder 1000]] flight to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency at the time of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]]. The flight was set to arrive at 1435 hours at Gate 2F, but was delayed, moving its scheduled departure time from 1530 hours to 1610.

The second was a non-stop [[StarSpeeder 3000]] flight to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] offered to passengers by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency around [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]].
